script_hooks.logic:
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let number be the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_weak" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If condition flag data4 at (the register's 'lastWeakElement') is up this frame, then
  Call helper4 with (this state).
  If hpRate is at most number, then choose state 15 next.
  Otherwise, choose state 13 next.
Otherwise, if hpRate is at most number, then choose state 12 next.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be the enemy → without-and-lot-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
  The enemy uses ability with options {ignoresReflection: true}.

script_hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrState".
If condition flag data4 at (the register's 'lastWeakElement') is up this frame, then
  Call helper4 with (this state).
  Choose state 16 next.
If the enemy is ready to act, then call helper3 with (this state).
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ABILITY_CONTINUOUS_MAGIC" is up this frame, then set the register's 'continuousMagicFlg' to true.
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ABILITY_AGGRESSOR" is up this frame, then set the register's 'aggressorFlg' to true.
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ABILITY_FLARE" is up this frame and the count "turnInCurrState" is at least 2, then set the register's 'flareFlg' to true.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v be unset.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
If not globalRegister's 'aggressorFlg', then
  Set v to the id of the move labelled "aggressor" on executer.
  Executer uses v with options {ignoresReflection: true} and stop.
If not globalRegister's 'flareFlg' and call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "turnInCurrState") is at least 2, then
  Set v to the id of the move labelled "flare" on executer.
  If globalRegister's 'continuousMagicFlg', then
    Executer → reset-atb.
    Executer uses v immediately with options {ignoresReflection: true}.
  Otherwise, executer uses v with options {ignoresReflection: true}.
  Stop.
Set v to executer → without-and-lot-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
If globalRegister's 'continuousMagicFlg', then
  If v is the id of the move labelled "flare" on executer or v is the id of the move labelled "clouder" on executer or v is the id of the move labelled "shock" on executer or v is the id of the move labelled "silega" on executer, then
    Executer → reset-atb.
    Executer uses v immediately with options {ignoresReflection: true}.
  Otherwise, executer uses v with options {ignoresReflection: true}.
Otherwise, executer uses v with options {ignoresReflection: true}.

Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let lastWeakElement be globalRegister's 'lastWeakElement'.
Let v be the items x in list where lastWeakElement is not x.

Set globalRegister's 'lastWeakElement' to lastWeakElement.
